lede: Wall Street's tech slide deepened on Monday, with the S&P 500 down 1.9% and the Nasdaq 2.5% as Nvidia sank ahead of tonight's results and new US curbs on AI-chip access. The dollar holds near its strongest since April 2025 with a December Fed hike almost fully priced, keeping gold near one-year lows and the euro pinned at 1.10.
snapshot_time: Mon 16 Nov US close · Brent 05:13 TRT

focus.text: Hovering near $3,860 after a one-year low as a firm dollar and ~5.1% US 10-year yields weigh. US retail sales at 16:30 TRT are today's main risk event.
Sitting on 1.1000, a 19-month low, after a 0.24% drop Monday with Fed-hike pricing near 96%. Watch US retail sales at 16:30 TRT and Nvidia's after-hours results.

calendar.event: Nvidia Q3 results (after US close, Wed TRT)

news.text: Chip stocks dragged Wall Street lower: S&P 500 −1.9%, Nasdaq −2.5%, Nvidia −4.1% and AMD −5.6% after Washington tightened remote access to advanced AI chips.
Futures put a December Fed hike near 96%; the dollar index sits at its highest since April 2025 and the 10-year yield holds around 5.12%.
Brent fell 3.5% Monday to $92.44 and slipped further below $92 in Asia as Hormuz shipments near pre-war levels and the IEA sees a Q4 surplus.
Sterling is on a six-day losing run near 1.3170 ahead of jobs data; markets price about an 80% chance of another BoE hike in December.
Chinese October activity data missed forecasts, sending A-shares to a 16-month low while the PBOC drained medium-term liquidity.
US spot bitcoin ETFs shed about $1.07bn last week, a third straight weekly outflow; BlackRock's IBIT alone lost $908m.
Ether ETFs posted a seventh consecutive week of outflows (−$399m), even as Bitmine added 7,653 ETH to its treasury.
Solana ETFs recorded a sixth weekly outflow (~$32m); SOL touched $67.41 over the weekend, its lowest since late June.
Strategy bought 485 BTC last week, lifting holdings to 850,849 BTC; Twenty One Capital and Strive also added coins on the dip.
Perp exchange Lighter paused all withdrawals after a $10.4m exploit.
Hyperliquid's HYPE outperformed with a ~6% daily gain while the broader market stabilised around BTC 65,000.
